audio.strategy: Recorded multi-sample acoustic grand piano (26 minor-third root notes D#1–F#7 across 3 velocity layers v3/v10/v16 from Salamander Grand Piano V3, 78 stereo Ogg Vorbis q4 files) with equal-temperament retuning via playbackRate, velocity-sensitive gain curve, damper release, sustain CC64, deterministic polyphony voice stealing, and a truthfully labeled live harmonic-synthesis fallback when samples are loading or unavailable.

generatedSources.name: Harmonic Piano Synthesis Fallback
generatedSources.description: Live Web Audio additive/filtered triangle+sine harmonic voice used only while recorded samples are still loading or if sample fetching/decoding fails. Clearly labeled as fallback in UI status.

notes: All 78 bundled audio files under public/samples/grand/ are verbatim trimmed and re-encoded cuts from inputs/samples/grand/salamander-grand-v3/Samples/ with no pitch-shifting, time-stretching, or layering baked into the files.
Fine retuning offsets from upstream Data/tune_ret.txt are applied at runtime via AudioBufferSourceNode.playbackRate for accurate A440 equal temperament.
Phase 1 connects only keybed/MIDI/computer-keyboard note input and sustain (CC64 / Space) to the basic piano voice; all panel controls remain truthfully decorative.
